notes: Winged creature (zephyrit). Winged-v1 rig template with hover gait, pale sky body, cream wings, sage belly, gold eyes. creature.small canvas (40x44, anchor 20,34).

fields.description: a bright little companion that follows the sea breeze and perches on high sails
fields.anatomy: plump aerodynamic avian-fae body, pair of broad rounded feather-wings spread wide, short feathered crest atop the head, tiny curved beak, small tucked talons under the body, delicate fan tail
fields.colours: pale sky-blue body plumage, soft cream wing primary feathers, light sage green underbelly, bright gold eyes
